item.description: Summary In this walkthrough, we will exploit the target by leaking a user’s password from LDAP and using the IIS web server with enabled WebDAV to upload a shell and gain code execution. item.title: BillyBoy - PG Practice
item.description: Summary Initial Foothold can be gain through password guessing or bruteforcing common passwords. After that Sonatype Nexus application remote code execution vulnerability can be exploited and gain Remote Code Execution on the target. Finally, the SMBGhost vulnerability can be exploited to escalate privileges.
